annotations.title: Compare a Hotel from Its Link

description: Compares prices for the one hotel behind a link from Booking.com, Agoda, Traveloka, Trip.com, Hotels.com or Airbnb: finds the same hotel on the other sites and lists each site's price for the whole stay, cheapest first, with a link to each. The dates and guests in the link are used when it has them, otherwise checkIn, checkOut and adults. Share links and links inside pasted text work too. Takes about 10-30 seconds.

adults.description: Number of adults, used when the link does not say (default 2).

checkIn.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD, used when the link has no dates.

checkOut.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD, used when the link has no dates.

childAges.description: Age of each child for supported family quotes.

language.description: Optional UI language hint. Only used when queryText gives no signal.

queryText.description: Short excerpt (one sentence at most) of the guest's latest message in their own words, used only to detect the reply language; it is not stored or forwarded. It carries no names, contact details or other parts of the conversation.

url.description: The hotel link as the user pasted it, e.g. 'https://www.agoda.com/radisson-hotel-danang/hotel/da-nang-vn.html'.

name: compare_hotel_link
title: Compare a Hotel from Its Link
